description: Agent Inventory: submit a physical stock count with the system stock record it answers to: the count with its reference, location, count date, who took it, its total units and each count line with its id, the item by SKU or name, the location, the units counted, the day counted when it differs and the sale references the line is used to explain; the system stock record with its reference, the day it is as of and each item it carries with its location and stock on hand; optionally the sales record with each sale’s reference, item, day and units. The signed report gives the count and the system record, the count total recomputed from the lines, each item counted against the items the system carries, each system item with stock on hand against the count lines, each count line used to explain a sale against the day of that sale, and each item and location read for a second count line, and counts them, and names a divergent stock count: a count total that does not recompute from the lines, an item counted that the system does not carry, a system item never counted, a count dated after the sale it is used to explain, and the same item counted twice at different quantities; then a line repeated at the same quantity, each variance from the stock on hand and a count dated apart from the system record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No count lines, no system items, no count total, or no dated sale beside a count line that explains one leaves those points unverified. Items match by their SKU or their words with plurals folded, a system item that names no location answers to every count line for the item, a system item carried at zero needs no count line, quantities compare to the hundredth of a unit and dates by the day. This reads whether the stock count and the system stock record can be trusted together, line by line. Verdict inventory_count_divergent, inventory_count_partial, inventory_count_unverified or inventory_count_consistent. POST /api/inventory-count-check. Reads the inventory records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never moves stock, never places or cancels an order, never writes to anyone’s inventory system and never adjusts a record, which stay with the business and its staff, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Inventory reads inventory records: a stock count, receiving records, shrinkage and loss records, a stock adjustment log, an inventory valuation, reorder records, a dead stock record and consignment stock records, each against the system stock record, the purchase or consignment orders, the count and sales records, the count and the period close, the counts and purchase records, the stock levels and lead times, the movement window and period report, or the sale and settlement records it answers to. The family checks whether the stock record can be trusted; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the ledger the stock feeds, and the boutique tools act on one store’s orders. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-inventory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-inventory/.
